7743: Set a rope at head height and half kneel facing the stack.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Return slowly. Switch the leading knee after your set.
7744: Set the rope at face height and grip it with your palms facing up.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows leading.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
7745: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.
7746: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down firmly.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom.
7747: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
7751: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
